name: MistralAI-Training
description: Mistral AI's training crawler. It collects web content to help build the datasets used to train Mistral's generative AI models, and is documented as separate from both the search-index crawler and the user-triggered fetcher. Mistral states webmasters can disallow this user agent in robots.txt.

instances: Mozilla/5.0 AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko; compatible; MistralAI-Training/1.0; +https://docs.mistral.ai/robots)
